title: Vivo V70 Series India Launch Today: Where To Watch Event, Expected Price And Specs | Tech News - News18
text: Vivo V70 series India launch is today and the company is looking to increase its available devices in the market, giving buyers more options. The company is going to build on the exciting phase in 2025 and offer more compelling products that are likely to face the brunt of the memory and storage price hikes. It has already launched the X200T in the country this year and now we are getting the new V70 and V70 Elite models. The latest V-series phones will have some firsts for the lineup for the brand. Vivo V70 Series India Launch, Event Timings And Where To Watch Vivo V70 series launch in India is confirmed for Thursday, February 19, 2026 and the company is hosting a livestream for the event which starts at 12:00 PM IST where you can get all the details, including the expected Vivo V70 series price in India. Vivo V70 Series India Launch: Price And Specs Expected The Vivo V70 and V70 Elite design looks different from its previous version with a square camera module, and a flatter body featuring an AMOLED display with 120Hz refresh rate. This looks to be a complete refresh for the brand as it looks to join the Elite company this month. The phones will also come with IP68 and IP69 ratings for better protection. Vivo V70 could be powered by Snapdragon 7 Gen 4 chipset, while the V70 Elite opts for the reliability of the Snapdragon 8s Gen 3 SoC with up to 12GB RAM expected to be paired with both the devices. The launch teaser suggests the V70 series will have a triple camera system with a 50MP main sensor and a 50MP telephoto lens along with another unit. And finally, Vivo is expected to pack a large 6,500mAh battery with 90W fast charging supported out of the box. Vivo V70 series price in India is tipped to get a price hike like most phone launches in the market this year. The V70 could start from around Rs 45,000 as per leaks while the V70 Elite features in the Rs 55,000 range when it will be available in the country.
